name: Clustal
instructions: Search clustal.org for {full_name}, open "view full record", and copy that page's address (the search result's address won't work). Open clustal.org/privacy-control, paste it, press "remove my info", enter {contact_email} and press "remove my info" again. Clustal emails a link to finish; OpenOptOut clicks it for you. Then press "I've done this".
source: Process per BADBOOL's Clustal entry (full-record URL, one email per listing, emailed opt-out link).
